newsitem.title: UK: UK's SIG makes agreed bid for Roskel.
newsitem.headline: UK's SIG makes agreed bid for Roskel.

text.p: British insulation and related products group SIG Plc said on Thursday it was making an agreed bid for Roskel Plc, which values the company at around 25.9 million stg.

SIG is offering four new shares for every nine Roskel shares, which based on SIG's closing price of 326p per share, values each Roskel share at 145p. A 135p per share cash alternative is also available.
The company has received acceptance of the offer from shareholders representing 52.3 percent of SIG's share capital.
SIG said the purchase, which it expects to enhance earnings in the first year, would further strengthen its position as a distributor in the UK of ceilings and partitioning systems.
